messages:
rachel: Heads-up 1 Harbor Analytics invoice INV-16001 failed with issuer AML block this morning. Seen 2026-11-02 13:14 UTC. Customer says their bank flagged the payment for additional KYC checks and declined.
dan: can you paste the stripe webhook/metadata so we see the failure_code and any risk flags?
rachel: pasted below:
```
event: evt_AML892
payment_intent: pi_AML892xxx
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: \"Declined: AML check failed\"
outcome.risk_level: 0.94
outcome.reason: aml_suspected
card_brand: Visa
last4: 7788
three_d_secure: not_required
```
compliance: tagging in 1 - if bank flagged AML we need KYC docs from the payer (beneficial owner, tax id) before accepting ACH. For wire we still require payer legal name + tax id and remittance details.
payments-ops: Pause automatic retries on harboranalytics.com until remit confirmed. If they can wire today, ops can record manual payment once we get bank ref.
billing-bot: Automatic retry schedule paused for harboranalytics_com.
rachel: Customer treasury replied 1 they can wire today but their bank insists on a copy of our AML/KYC and an invoice showing beneficiary details. They requested same-day wire instructions and a signed invoice with our company registration number.
dan: Finance,
please create manual invoice INV-16002 for $27,900 (monthly + excess) net 1 day and include our company registration # and bank beneficiary details in the PDF. GL 4550. Also note "Customer requested same-day wire due to issuer AML hold."
compliance: We'll provide a redacted copy of our KYC and our bank's correspondent info from the vault. Please do not put full internal account numbers in the invoice; use beneficiary name + bank name and attach KYC cert in secure email.
payments-ops: Creating INV-16002 and preparing secure bank link. Example internal API to record manual wire (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-16002","amount_cents":2790000,"method":"wire","note":"Harbor Analytics same-day wire 2026-11-02"}'
```
rachel: Customer also asked if we can accept split payment (half wire now, half ACH after KYC completes). Is that allowed?
compliance: Split payments ok if legal/payer identity verified. We need payer legal name, tax id, and beneficial owner confirmation before accepting partial ACH. Log KYC checklist: gov ID + tax cert + proof of address.
dan: Approve one-time waiver of the 1% late fee for goodwill while they resolve bank hold. Approver: dan. Please log waiver and reason.
billing-bot: Manual invoice INV-16002 created and emailed to treasury@harboranalytics.io. Original invoice INV-16001 retries suspended.
rachel: Sending secure email with invoice PDF + KYC redacted cert (from vault). Also asked treasury to confirm whether they will send full wire or split. Call scheduled 15:00 ET.
payments-ops: Reminder: when you get bank reference include it in the manual API call payload and attach remittance proof to Netsuite. Do NOT paste account numbers in Slack.
rachel: Call update 1 treasury will initiate half-wire now and send ACH for remainder after KYC clears. They provided redacted bank ref HARB-WIRE-11 (uploaded to vault).
payments-ops: Received bank ref HARB-WIRE-11. Recording manual payment for 50% now (amount_cents:1395000) and marking INV-16002 as partially paid. We'll await ACH remainder and mark paid once settled.
billing-bot: INV-16002 status: partially_paid (1395000 cents recorded). Retry schedule remains paused until final settlement.
stripe-agent: Opening Stripe support case stripe_case_20261102-HARB to log AML-related declines and request any metadata we can provide programmatically to reduce false positives.
compliance: I've logged the KYC docs and the payer confirmation in the compliance tracker. Please attach the compliance case ID to the invoice memo.
dan: thanks all. Keep thread updated when ACH completes. Approver note: late fee waived by dan for this cycle. :white_check_mark: :lock:
